name: Hôtel du Couvent, a Luxury Collection Hotel
insider_take: This converted 17th-century Dominican convent seamlessly blends sacred history with French Riviera glamour in the heart of Nice's Old Town.
whats_special: The hotel preserves original convent architecture including vaulted ceilings, stone archways, and a stunning central cloister courtyard. Located just steps from the famous Cours Saleya flower market, you're in the pulse of Vieux Nice's cobblestone streets where monks once walked in silence.
pro_tip: Book a room overlooking the interior courtyard for the most authentic convent experience, and visit the Cours Saleya market early morning when vendors set up their colorful flower displays.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers panoramic views of the Baie des Anges, while the building's location puts you within a 2-minute walk of the Cathédrale Sainte-Réparate and the vibrant restaurant scene of Old Town's narrow medieval streets.
pros: Historic convent architecture with modern luxury amenities
Prime location in Nice's old town near attractions and beaches
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and privileges
cons: Limited parking availability due to historic city center location
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and exclusive location
